profile.summary: Playworks is a national nonprofit that helps schools and youth programs create safe, active play. It offers staff training, consultative support, online learning and onsite coaches for schools, districts and youth organizations. Its stated mission is to improve children's health and well-being through physical activity and safe, meaningful play.

review.notes: Playworks' own contact page shows a 501(c)(3) with its address at 1440 Broadway, Oakland, CA and phone 510.893.4180, matching the agenda name and location; its site describes onsite coaches, staff training, consultative support and online learning for schools, which fits OUSD's school-based services agreements. The summary, orgType, address, phone and website are all supported and neutral.
